b1-12-01.title: Communicative Challenge: When Is the Soup Ready?
b1-12-01.scenario: Meg is helping Károly's mother, Ildikó, cook the family gulyás. Ildikó asks when the dish will be ready. You (Meg) say that the soup is cooked in two hours and that the meat becomes soft in an hour.
b1-12-01.prompt: Tell Ildikó when the soup is cooked and when the meat becomes soft.
cues: Say how long it takes for the soup to be cooked
Say how long it takes for the meat to become soft
b1-12-01.target: A leves két óra alatt megfő. A hús egy óra alatt megpuhul.
b1-12-01.english: The soup is cooked in two hours. The meat becomes soft in an hour.
b1-12-01.canDo: I can describe cooking and baking processes using mediopassive verbs (megfő, megsül, megpuhul).

b1-12-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Eat
b1-12-02.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg how often she eats vegetables and fruit. You (Meg) say that you eat vegetables regularly and fruit twice a day.
b1-12-02.prompt: Tell Ildikó how often you eat vegetables and fruit.
cues: Say that you eat vegetables regularly
Say how many times a day you eat fruit
b1-12-02.target: Rendszeresen eszem zöldséget. Naponta kétszer eszem gyümölcsöt.
b1-12-02.english: I regularly eat vegetables. I eat fruit twice a day.
b1-12-02.canDo: I can say how often I do something with rendszeresen, naponta, időnként and ritkán.

b1-12-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Ildikó's Gulyás, Step by Step
b1-12-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg how to start Ildikó's gulyás, which she learned in his mother's kitchen. You (Meg) say that first you cut up the onion, then you add the meat and the paprika.
b1-12-03.prompt: Tell Károly the first two steps of the gulyás.
cues: Say what you do first
Say what you add next
b1-12-03.target: Először vágjuk fel a hagymát, majd adjuk hozzá a húst és a paprikát.
b1-12-03.english: First we cut up the onion, then we add the meat and the paprika.
b1-12-03.canDo: I can put the steps of a recipe in order with először, majd, miután and végül.

b1-12-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Real Hungarikum
b1-12-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg which Hungarian food she likes most. You (Meg) say that goulash is a real hungarikum and that it is spicy.
b1-12-04.prompt: Tell Petra what you think is a real hungarikum and how it tastes.
cues: Say which dish is a real hungarikum
Say how it tastes
b1-12-04.target: A gulyás igazi hungarikum. Nagyon fűszeres.
b1-12-04.english: Goulash is a real hungarikum. It is very spicy.
b1-12-04.canDo: I can say what a hungarikum is and name one.

b1-12-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Asking for the Bill
b1-12-05.scenario: Meg and Károly have finished dinner in a restaurant. You (Meg) call the waiter, politely ask him to bring the bill, and say that you pay by card.
b1-12-05.prompt: Ask the waiter politely for the bill and say how you pay.
cues: Ask the waiter politely to bring the bill
Say that you pay by card
b1-12-05.target: Legyen szíves, hozna a számlát? Kártyával fizetünk.
b1-12-05.english: Could you please bring the bill? We pay by card.
b1-12-05.canDo: I can interact politely with restaurant staff, order multi-course meals, and request the bill.

b1-12-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What We Cooked
b1-12-consolidation.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg what you did first in the kitchen today. You (Meg) say that first you cut up the onion, and that the meat became soft in an hour.
b1-12-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ildikó what you did first and what happened to the meat.
cues: Say what you did first
Say what happened to the meat
b1-12-consolidation.target: Először felvágtuk a hagymát, majd a hús egy óra alatt megpuhult.
b1-12-consolidation.english: First we cut up the onion, then the meat became soft in an hour.
b1-12-consolidation.canDo: I can describe food cooking processes using mediopassive verbs.

b1-13-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Spokesperson Said
b1-13-01.scenario: Károly missed the evening news. You (Meg) watched it: the spokesperson said that the minister arrives tomorrow.
b1-13-01.prompt: Tell Károly what the spokesperson said.
cues: Say that the spokesperson said something
Say that the minister arrives tomorrow
b1-13-01.target: A szóvivő azt mondta, hogy a miniszter holnap érkezik.
b1-13-01.english: The spokesperson said that the minister arrives tomorrow.
b1-13-01.canDo: I can report what someone said using azt mondta, hogy.

b1-13-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Reporter Asked
b1-13-02.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) what happened at the press conference. A reporter asked whether the news is true, and the spokesperson confirmed it.
b1-13-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the reporter asked and what the spokesperson did.
cues: Say what the reporter asked
Say that the spokesperson confirmed it
b1-13-02.target: A tudósító azt kérdezte, hogy igaz-e a hír. A szóvivő megerősítette.
b1-13-02.english: The reporter asked whether the news is true. The spokesperson confirmed it.
b1-13-02.canDo: I can report a question using azt kérdezte, hogy and -e.

b1-13-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Is the Photo Real?
b1-13-03.scenario: Petra shows you (Meg) a photo online. People say it is genuine, but you are not sure that the news about it is true.
b1-13-03.prompt: Tell Petra that the photo is allegedly genuine, but that you doubt the news.
cues: Say that the photo is allegedly genuine
Say that it is doubtful whether the news is true
b1-13-03.target: Állítólag a fénykép valódi, de kétséges, hogy igaz a hír.
b1-13-03.english: Allegedly the photo is genuine, but it is doubtful whether the news is true.
b1-13-03.canDo: I can show that news is only hearsay using állítólag and úgy tűnik.

b1-13-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Truth Came Out
b1-13-04.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) how the story about the accident ended. After the investigation, it turned out that the news was not true.
b1-13-04.prompt: Tell Petra how the story ended and how people reacted.
cues: Say that it turned out after the investigation that the news is not true
Say that public opinion calmed down
b1-13-04.target: A nyomozás után kiderült, hogy a hír nem igaz. A közvélemény megnyugodott.
b1-13-04.english: After the investigation it turned out that the news is not true. Public opinion calmed down.
b1-13-04.canDo: I can say that the truth came out using kiderült, hogy.

b1-13-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides of Online News
b1-13-05.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) what you think about online news in an op-ed discussion at home.
b1-13-05.prompt: Tell Petra the two sides of online news: it is fast, but there is a lot of fake news.
cues: Say that on the one hand the internet is fast
Say that on the other hand there is a lot of fake news
b1-13-05.target: Egyfelől gyors az internet, másfelől sok az álhír.
b1-13-05.english: On the one hand the internet is fast, on the other hand there is a lot of fake news.
b1-13-05.canDo: I can balance two points of view using egyfelől … másfelől.

b1-13-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Check the Source
b1-13-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) whether the news is true. The spokesperson said it is not, and you always check the news source.
b1-13-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the spokesperson said, and what you always check.
cues: Say that according to the spokesperson the news is not true
Say that you always check the news source
b1-13-consolidation.target: A szóvivő szerint a hír nem igaz. Én mindig ellenőrzöm a hírforrást.
b1-13-consolidation.english: According to the spokesperson, the news is not true. I always check the news source.
b1-13-consolidation.canDo: I can report what someone said and check where news comes from.

b1-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Making a Room Homely
b1-10-01.scenario: Anna comes to see Meg and Károly's flat. She notices the new lamp in the living room and asks what you did with the small room next to it. You (Meg) say that the new lamp makes the room homely, and that you converted the small room into an office.
b1-10-01.prompt: Tell Anna what the new lamp does and what you made of the small room.
cues: Say what the new lamp makes of the room
Say what you converted the small room into
b1-10-01.target: Az új lámpa otthonossá teszi a szobát. A kis szobát átalakítottuk irodává.
b1-10-01.english: The new lamp makes the room homely. We converted the small room into an office.
b1-10-01.canDo: I can express transformation and change of state using the translative case -vá / -vé.

b1-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Flat
b1-10-02.scenario: Anna has not seen Meg and Károly's flat yet and asks what it is like. You (Meg) say that you have a balcony where you drink coffee in the morning, and that the flat on the second floor is comfortable.
b1-10-02.prompt: Tell Anna about the balcony and about the flat.
cues: Say what you have and what you do there in the morning
Say where the flat is and that it is comfortable
b1-10-02.target: Van egy erkélyünk, ahol reggel kávét iszunk. A lakás, amely a második emeleten van, nagyon kényelmes.
b1-10-02.english: We have a balcony where we drink coffee in the morning. The flat, which is on the second floor, is very comfortable.
b1-10-02.canDo: I can describe a home with relative clauses (amely, ami, ahol).

b1-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Lease Says
b1-10-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the lease says about the money. You (Meg) tell him that you are obliged to pay the utilities every month and that you have no choice but to pay a two-month deposit.
b1-10-03.prompt: Tell Károly what you are obliged to pay every month and what you have no choice but to pay now.
cues: Say what you are obliged to pay every month
Say what you have no choice but to pay now
b1-10-03.target: Kötelesek vagyunk havonta fizetni a rezsit. Kénytelenek vagyunk két havi kauciót fizetni.
b1-10-03.english: We are obliged to pay the utilities every month. We have no choice but to pay a two-month deposit.
b1-10-03.canDo: I can say what someone is obliged to do, using köteles and kénytelen.

b1-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Does the Table Go?
b1-10-04.scenario: Károly and Meg are arranging the living room, and Károly asks where the small table and the shelf should go. You (Meg) say that the sofa is by the wall, the small table goes in front of it and the shelf above it.
b1-10-04.prompt: Tell Károly where the sofa is, and what goes in front of it and above it.
cues: Say where the sofa is
Say what goes in front of it
Say what goes above it
b1-10-04.target: A kanapé a fal mellett van, előtte van egy kis asztal, fölötte pedig egy polc.
b1-10-04.english: The sofa is by the wall, in front of it is a small table, and above it is a shelf.
b1-10-04.canDo: I can describe the layout and arrangement of furniture in an apartment.

b1-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Matters in a Home
b1-10-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg what is important to her and Károly in a home. You (Meg) say that it is important that the flat is quiet and bright, and that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-05.prompt: Tell Anna what is important to you in a home.
cues: Say that it matters that the flat is quiet and bright
Say what matters about the heating
b1-10-05.target: Fontos, hogy a lakás csendes és világos legyen. Nekem az a fontos, hogy a fűtés olcsó legyen.
b1-10-05.english: It is important that the flat is quiet and bright. What matters to me is that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-05.canDo: I can say what matters to me in a home, using Fontos, hogy ...

b1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Changes at Home
b1-10-consolidation.scenario: Anna asks Meg what she and Károly are doing with the flat this autumn. You (Meg) say that you are turning the small room into an office, and that it is important that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna what you are doing with the small room and what matters about the heating.
cues: Say what you are turning the small room into
Say what matters about the heating
b1-10-consolidation.target: A kis szobát átalakítjuk irodává. Fontos, hogy a fűtés olcsó legyen.
b1-10-consolidation.english: We are turning the small room into an office. It is important that the heating is cheap.
b1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can use the translative case -vá / -vé to describe home improvements.

b1-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Problems to Solve
b1-14-01.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) how things are at the company where Petra works. You say that there are many problems to be solved there today.
b1-14-01.prompt: Tell Károly that there are many problems to be solved at the company today.
cues: Say that there are many problems today
Say that they are problems to be solved
b1-14-01.target: A cégnél ma sok a megoldandó probléma.
b1-14-01.english: There are many problems to be solved at the company today.
b1-14-01.canDo: I can describe a task that still has to be done using -andó / -endő.

b1-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Upload the Document
b1-14-02.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) what she should do with a document so that everyone on the network can see it. You tell her to upload it.
b1-14-02.prompt: Ask Petra politely to upload the document to the network.
cues: Ask her politely to do something
Say that she should upload the document to the network
b1-14-02.target: Kérlek, töltsd fel a dokumentumot a hálózatra!
b1-14-02.english: Please upload the document to the network!
b1-14-02.canDo: I can use verb prefixes like fel- and le- in tech phrases such as feltölt and letölt.

b1-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Less Screen Time
b1-14-03.scenario: Petra worries that her little brother spends too much time on his phone. You (Meg) say that for the sake of children's health, one should limit screen time.
b1-14-03.prompt: Tell Petra what to do for the sake of the children's health.
cues: Say that it is for the sake of the children's health
Say that screen time must be limited
b1-14-03.target: A gyerekek egészsége érdekében korlátozzuk a képernyőidőt.
b1-14-03.english: For the sake of the children's health, let us limit screen time.
b1-14-03.canDo: I can give formal advice using érdekében, like a biztonság érdekében.

b1-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Update the App
b1-14-04.scenario: Your older neighbour asks you (Meg) how to update an app on her phone. You answer politely, addressing her as Ön.
b1-14-04.prompt: Tell your neighbour politely to open the settings and update the app.
cues: Tell her to open the settings
Tell her to update the app
b1-14-04.target: Nyissa meg a beállításokat, és frissítse az alkalmazást!
b1-14-04.english: Open the settings and update the app!
b1-14-04.canDo: I can give a polite instruction using forms like Nyissa meg.

b1-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Then and Now
b1-14-05.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) how friends kept in touch in the past and how they do it today. You say that earlier people wrote letters, while today they send messages.
b1-14-05.prompt: Tell Károly how it was earlier and how it is today.
cues: Say what people did earlier
Say what people do today
b1-14-05.target: Míg korábban levelet írtunk, addig ma üzenetet küldünk.
b1-14-05.english: While earlier we wrote letters, today we send messages.
b1-14-05.canDo: I can contrast then and now with míg … addig.

b1-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Apps and Users
b1-14-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) about the new app. You say that every user likes it and that data protection is important.
b1-14-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what every user likes and what is important.
cues: Say that every user likes the app
Say that data protection is important
b1-14-consolidation.target: Minden felhasználó szereti ezt az alkalmazást. Fontos az adatvédelem.
b1-14-consolidation.english: Every user likes this app. Data protection is important.
b1-14-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about apps, users and data protection in a few sentences.

b1-15-01.title: Communicative Challenge: More Concerts, More Music
b1-15-01.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) why you go to so many concerts. You say that the more concerts you go to, the more you like music.
b1-15-01.prompt: Tell Petra how going to concerts changes how much you like music.
cues: Say that you go to more concerts
Say that you like music better because of it
b1-15-01.target: Minél többet járok koncertre, annál jobban szeretem a zenét.
b1-15-01.english: The more I go to concerts, the more I like music.
b1-15-01.canDo: I can say that one thing grows with another using minél … annál ….

b1-15-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Saturday Concert
b1-15-02.scenario: Károly wants to go out on Saturday and asks you (Meg) for an idea. You recommend the Saturday concert and say that it would be a pity to miss it.
b1-15-02.prompt: Recommend the Saturday concert to Károly.
cues: Say that it is worth going to the concert
Say that it would be a pity to miss it
b1-15-02.target: Érdemes elmenni a szombati koncertre, kár lenne kihagyni!
b1-15-02.english: It is worth going to Saturday's concert; it would be a pity to miss it!
b1-15-02.canDo: I can recommend something using érdemes and kár lenne kihagyni.

b1-15-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long but Good Film
b1-15-03.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) about the film you saw yesterday. You say that although the film was long, everyone liked it, and that the lead actor was very good.
b1-15-03.prompt: Tell Károly what you thought of the film.
cues: Say that the film was long, but everyone liked it
Say that the lead actor was very good
b1-15-03.target: Bár a film hosszú volt, mindenkinek tetszett. A főszereplő nagyon jól játszott.
b1-15-03.english: Although the film was long, everyone liked it. The lead actor acted very well.
b1-15-03.canDo: I can balance praise and criticism with bár or noha.

b1-15-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Recognized Festival
b1-15-04.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) whether the summer festival is well known. You say that it is a very recognized festival and part of the cultural heritage.
b1-15-04.prompt: Tell Petra how well known the festival is.
cues: Say that it is a very recognized festival
Say that it is part of the cultural heritage
b1-15-04.target: Ez egy nagyon elismert fesztivál, és a magyar kulturális örökség része.
b1-15-04.english: This is a very recognized festival, and part of Hungarian cultural heritage.
b1-15-04.canDo: I can describe a person or work as recognized using elismert and similar participles.

b1-15-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Close to My Heart
b1-15-05.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) about your taste in music. You say that Hungarian music is very close to your heart.
b1-15-05.prompt: Tell Károly what music is close to your heart.
cues: Say which music you mean
Say that it is very close to your heart
b1-15-05.target: A magyar zene nagyon közel áll a szívemhez.
b1-15-05.english: Hungarian music is very close to my heart.
b1-15-05.canDo: I can say that something is close to my heart or alien to me with közel áll and távol áll.

b1-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Best Concert
b1-15-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks you (Meg) about yesterday's concert. You say that it was the best concert you have ever seen and that everyone liked it.
b1-15-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what you thought of the concert.
cues: Say that it was the best concert you have ever seen
Say that everyone liked it
b1-15-consolidation.target: Ez volt a legjobb koncert, amit valaha láttam. Mindenkinek tetszett.
b1-15-consolidation.english: This was the best concert I have ever seen. Everyone liked it.
b1-15-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about a concert, a film and my taste in a few sentences.

b1-11-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Neighbourhood We Live In
b1-11-01.scenario: Károly's mother, Ildikó, asks Meg what the neighbourhood is like where she and Károly live. You (Meg) say that the neighbourhood in which you live is very quiet, and that there are many parks, which is very good.
b1-11-01.prompt: Tell Ildikó what the neighbourhood in which you live is like and what you think about the parks.
cues: Say that the neighbourhood where you live is quiet
Say there are many parks and that you think this is good
b1-11-01.target: A környék, amelyben lakunk, nagyon csendes. Sok park van, ami nagyon jó.
b1-11-01.english: The neighbourhood in which we live is very quiet. There are many parks, which is very good.
b1-11-01.canDo: I can describe a town and its people with relative pronouns (amelyben, akinek, amiről, ahová).

b1-11-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Street Party
b1-11-02.scenario: Károly's father, Gábor, asks Meg who comes to the street party in her neighbourhood. You (Meg) say that the people of the neighbourhood organize a joint celebration every year, and that everybody helps.
b1-11-02.prompt: Tell Gábor who organizes the celebration and how often, and that everybody helps.
cues: Say who organizes the joint celebration and how often
Say that everybody helps
b1-11-02.target: A környékbeli emberek minden évben közös ünnepet szerveznek. Mindenki segít.
b1-11-02.english: The people of the neighbourhood organize a joint celebration every year. Everybody helps.
b1-11-02.canDo: I can form adjectives with -beli to say where people or things are from (falubeli, helybeli).

b1-11-03.title: Communicative Challenge: City or Village?
b1-11-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether she would rather live in the city or in a village. You (Meg) say that in the city there is a lot of work, but in the countryside, however, life is quieter.
b1-11-03.prompt: Tell Károly what is good about the city and then contrast it with the countryside.
cues: Say what there is a lot of in the city
Contrast it with life in the countryside
b1-11-03.target: A városban sok a munka. Vidéken azonban csendesebb az élet.
b1-11-03.english: In the city there is a lot of work. In the countryside, however, life is quieter.
b1-11-03.canDo: I can contrast two things with azonban, viszont and ezzel szemben.

b1-11-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What to See in Szeged
b1-11-04.scenario: Petra is going to Szeged for a weekend, where Meg and Károly stayed in a hotel, and asks Meg what to visit. You (Meg) say that it is definitely worth visiting the church in Szeged, and that if she can, she should also go to the river.
b1-11-04.prompt: Tell Petra what is definitely worth visiting in Szeged and what she should also do if she can.
cues: Say what is definitely worth visiting in Szeged
Say where she should go too, if she can
b1-11-04.target: Szegeden mindenképpen érdemes meglátogatni a templomot. Ha teheted, menj el a Tiszához is.
b1-11-04.english: In Szeged it is definitely worth visiting the church. If you can, go to the Tisza too.
b1-11-04.canDo: I can recommend tourist destinations, sights, and hospitality venues in Hungary.

b1-11-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Taking Part
b1-11-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether she is taking part in the neighbourhood programme on Saturday. You (Meg) say that you take part in the programme, and that you trust your friend, who organizes it.
b1-11-05.prompt: Tell Károly that you take part in the programme and that you trust your friend.
cues: Say that you take part in the programme
Say that you trust your friend
b1-11-05.target: Részt veszek a programban. Bízom a barátomban.
b1-11-05.english: I am taking part in the programme. I trust my friend.
b1-11-05.canDo: I can say what I take part in, trust or believe in, with verbs that take -ban/-ben.

b1-11-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: City and Village
b1-11-consolidation.scenario: Gábor asks Meg what the city where she works is like compared with a village. You (Meg) say that the city in which you work is very busy, and that in the village, on the other hand, life is quiet.
b1-11-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gábor what the city in which you work is like, then say how the village is different.
cues: Say that the city where you work is busy
Say what the village is like instead
b1-11-consolidation.target: A város, amelyben dolgozom, nagyon forgalmas. A faluban viszont csendes az élet.
b1-11-consolidation.english: The city in which I work is very busy. In the village, on the other hand, life is quiet.
b1-11-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a town with relative pronouns such as amelyben and amiről.
